notes: One home per fact. Prose, tables and badges must agree with these numbers; `scripts/check-facts.mjs` enforces the ones a machine can check.

These are the counts that caused real defects when they drifted: the family roster was stated four different ways, the pitfall list was '30+' in one language and '20+' in another, and the mirror page count was '215' long after it reached 429.

seams.note: An audit claimed 14 detectable / 5 advisory. Counting the records in data/seams/index.json gives 10 / 9. The audit figure was never verified; these are the counted values, and scripts/check-facts.mjs asserts them against the index.

family.note: PerryLink DSH plugin family. Roster rows are what the family table actually lists; active = roster minus frozen minus retired. Re-verified 2026-10-13 against GitHub default branches.
